function decode64(s){const bin=atob(s);const bytes=new Uint8Array(bin.length);for(let i=0;i<bin.length;i++)bytes[i]=bin.charCodeAt(i);return new TextDecoder().decode(bytes)}
const MASTER_REFERENCE_HEXES=['#ff6b45','#84e6c2','#ffd68a','#86c9ff','#bba5ff','#65e49a','#ffd166','#ff7a70'];
function countMatches(text,re){return (text.match(re)||[]).length}
function visibleText(html){
  const doc=new DOMParser().parseFromString(html,'text/html');
  doc.querySelectorAll('script,style,noscript,svg').forEach(n=>n.remove());
  return (doc.body?.textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
}
function auditPage(key){
  const html=decode64(PAGES[key]),lower=html.toLowerCase(),copy=visibleText(html);
  const tiles=[...html.matchAll(/data-tile=["'](8|5|3|2|1a|1b)["']/gi)].map(m=>m[1].toLowerCase());
  const wanted=['8','5','3','2','1a','1b'];
  const exactFlow=wanted.every(x=>tiles.filter(v=>v===x).length===1)&&wanted.every((x,i)=>tiles.indexOf(x)===i);
  const mathCopy=countMatches(html,/\b(?:fibonacci|golden ratio|golden section|phi flow|phi convergence)\b|φ/gi);
  const cloned=MASTER_REFERENCE_HEXES.filter(h=>lower.includes(h)).length;
  return {
    gradient:countMatches(html,/(?:linear|radial|conic)-gradient|\b(?:bg|text)-gradient[-:]/gi),
    gradientText:countMatches(html,/bg-clip-text|text-transparent/gi),
    hugeRound:countMatches(html,/rounded-(?:2xl|3xl)/gi),
    emoji:countMatches(html,/\p{Extended_Pictographic}/gu),
    mathCopy,cloned,tileCount:tiles.length,exactFlow,
    reduced:/prefers-reduced-motion/i.test(html),
    narrow:/@media[^\{]*(?:max-width|max-inline-size)\s*:\s*(?:[0-9.]+)(?:px|rem|em)/i.test(html)
  };
}
function metric(label,value){return `<div class="metric"><b>${value}</b><span>${label}</span></div>`}
function auditSide(title,key){
  const m=auditPage(key);
  const flags=[
    m.mathCopy?`<span class="flag bad">math copy leakage ${m.mathCopy}</span>`:`<span class="flag good">no math-copy marker</span>`,
    m.cloned?`<span class="flag bad">reference accents ${m.cloned}/8</span>`:`<span class="flag good">no tracked accent clone</span>`,
    m.exactFlow?`<span class="flag good">F3 source order present</span>`:`<span class="flag bad">F3 source order absent</span>`,
    (m.reduced&&m.narrow)?`<span class="flag good">F5 source hooks present</span>`:`<span class="flag bad">F5 source hooks incomplete</span>`
  ].join('');
  return `<div class="audit-side"><h3>${title}</h3><div class="metric-grid">${metric('gradient markers',m.gradient)}${metric('gradient text',m.gradientText)}${metric('rounded 2xl/3xl',m.hugeRound)}${metric('emoji in visible copy',m.emoji)}${metric('math terms in source strings',m.mathCopy)}${metric('data-tile roles',m.tileCount)}</div><div class="audit-flags">${flags}</div></div>`;
}
function renderSourceAudits(){
  document.querySelectorAll('.experiment').forEach(exp=>{
    const frames=[...exp.querySelectorAll('.live-frame')]; if(frames.length!==2)return;
    const panel=document.createElement('div');panel.className='audit-panel';
    panel.innerHTML=`<div class="audit-head"><b>Reproducible source audit</b><small>Automatic markers only · not a visual-quality score</small></div><div class="audit-grid">${auditSide('Control · − Math-by-Design',frames[0].dataset.page)}${auditSide('Treatment · + Math-by-Design',frames[1].dataset.page)}</div><div class="audit-note">F1 identity and F4 variation remain manual. F2 needs rendered geometry; F6 needs computed foreground/background use. Marker counts intentionally expose leakage and style drift without pretending they prove quality.</div>`;
    exp.querySelector('.prompt-delta')?.insertAdjacentElement('afterend',panel);
  });
}
function setPage(frame,key){frame.srcdoc=decode64(PAGES[key])}
function scaleFrames(){document.querySelectorAll('.viewport-shell').forEach(shell=>{const frame=shell.querySelector('iframe');const s=shell.clientWidth/1440;frame.style.transform=`scale(${s})`;})}
renderSourceAudits();
document.querySelectorAll('.live-frame').forEach(f=>setPage(f,f.dataset.page));
scaleFrames(); addEventListener('resize',scaleFrames);

document.querySelectorAll('[data-shot]').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{const key=btn.dataset.shot;document.getElementById('shotFull').src=SHOTS[key];document.getElementById('shotTitle').textContent='Unaltered prompt screenshot · '+key.replace('-', ' / ');document.getElementById('shotDialog').showModal();}));
document.querySelectorAll('.open-render').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{const key=btn.dataset.render;const f=document.getElementById('renderFull');f.srcdoc=decode64(PAGES[key]);document.getElementById('renderTitle').textContent='Full live render · '+key.replace('-', ' / ');document.getElementById('renderDialog').showModal();}));
